title: What came between Republic of Florence and Grand Duchy of Tuscany?
question: What came between Republic of Florence and Grand Duchy of Tuscany?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Republic of Florence (1115) to Grand Duchy of Tuscany (1569): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
